name: Mythological Retelling
description: A structured 12-chapter template for modern retellings of Indian epics.

chapters.title: The Divine Prophecy
chapters.description: Introduce the protagonist's ordinary life and the subtle signs of their true destiny.

chapters.title: The Call of Dharma
chapters.description: A crisis disrupts the status quo, forcing the protagonist to choose between duty and desire.

chapters.title: The Guru's Ashram
chapters.description: The protagonist seeks out a mentor or begins training, learning ancient truths.

chapters.title: The Rival's Shadow
chapters.description: Introduction of the antagonist or a bitter rivalry that will define the conflict.

chapters.title: The Cosmic Weapon
chapters.description: Acquiring a significant tool, blessing, or realization (the Astra).

chapters.title: The Assembly of Allies
chapters.description: Gathering companions, each representing different facets of Indian society or mythology.

chapters.title: The Illusion of Maya
chapters.description: A major deception or betrayal that throws the protagonist off their path.

chapters.title: The Exile
chapters.description: A period of isolation, reflection, and suffering.

chapters.title: The Righteous Anger
chapters.description: The turning point where the protagonist resolves to fight back, embracing their destiny.

chapters.title: The Battlefield
chapters.description: The grand confrontation between dharma and adharma.

chapters.title: The Sacrifice
chapters.description: A heavy price is paid for victory; a moral ambiguity is explored.

chapters.title: The Ascent
chapters.description: Resolution and the restoration of cosmic order.
